Project.NAME: yascheduler
Project.keywords: scheduler, SSH, cloud, HPC, AiiDA, orchestration
Project.annotation: Schedules scientific calculation jobs on SSH machines and cloud-created nodes.

M-SCHEDULER.NAME: Scheduler
M-SCHEDULER.purpose: Main async daemon orchestrating task allocation, execution, and completion.
M-SCHEDULER.depends: M-DB, M-CLOUD-MANAGER, M-REMOTE-REPO, M-CONFIG, M-QUEUE, M-COMPAT, M-TIME, M-VARIABLES

class-Scheduler.PURPOSE: Async daemon that drives the full task lifecycle

fn-get_logger.PURPOSE: Configure and return the yascheduler logger

fn-create.PURPOSE: Async factory: builds Scheduler with DB, clouds, remote machines

fn-start.PURPOSE: Start all producer-consumer loops and run forever

fn-stop.PURPOSE: Graceful shutdown of all loops and connections

fn-allocate_task.PURPOSE: Pick a free node or create a cloud node for a task

fn-consume_task.PURPOSE: Upload inputs, spawn process, monitor completion

fn-create_new_task.PURPOSE: Insert a new TO_DO task into the database

fn-upload_task_data.PURPOSE: SFTP upload of task input files to remote machine

fn-start_task_on_machine.PURPOSE: Spawn calculation process on a remote node

fn-connect_machine_producer.PURPOSE: Yield enabled nodes from DB for connection

fn-connect_machine_consumer.PURPOSE: SSH-connect to a node and register it

fn-allocator_producer.PURPOSE: Yield TO_DO tasks ready for allocation

fn-allocator_consumer.PURPOSE: Allocate a machine for a task

fn-task_consumer_producer.PURPOSE: Yield RUNNING tasks for consumption check

fn-task_consumer_consumer.PURPOSE: Check task completion and download outputs

fn-deallocator_producer.PURPOSE: Yield idle cloud nodes for deallocation

fn-deallocator_consumer.PURPOSE: Delete idle cloud node and disable in DB

M-DB.NAME: Database layer
M-DB.purpose: PostgreSQL persistence for tasks, nodes, and their statuses.

class-DB.PURPOSE: Async PostgreSQL wrapper for tasks and nodes

fn-set_task_running.PURPOSE: Mark task RUNNING and bind to IP

fn-set_task_done.PURPOSE: Mark task DONE and update metadata

fn-set_task_error.PURPOSE: Mark task with error and optional message

M-CLIENT.NAME: Client API
M-CLIENT.purpose: Public Python/CLI client for submitting and querying tasks.

class-Yascheduler.PURPOSE: Sync/async client wrapper for task operations

fn-to_sync.PURPOSE: Decorator converting async function to sync

M-QUEUE.NAME: Unique queue
M-QUEUE.purpose: Deduplicating async queue for producer-consumer scheduling loops.

class-UniqueQueue.PURPOSE: Async queue that skips duplicate messages by ID

class-UMessage.PURPOSE: Typed message with ID and payload

M-AIIDA.NAME: AiiDA plugin
M-AIIDA.purpose: AiiDA scheduler plugin entry point for integrating with AiiDA workflows.

class-YaschedJobResource.PURPOSE: Resource class for yascheduler jobs in AiiDA

class-YaScheduler.PURPOSE: AiiDA Scheduler subclass for the yascheduler engine

M-VARIABLES.NAME: Project variables
M-VARIABLES.purpose: Global constants for config file, PID file, and log file paths.

M-UTILS.NAME: Utilities
M-UTILS.purpose: CLI entry points: submit, status, init, node management, daemonize.
M-UTILS.depends: M-CLIENT, M-CONFIG, M-DB, M-REMOTE, M-VARIABLES, M-SCHEDULER

fn-submit.PURPOSE: Submit task to yascheduler via AiiDA script

fn-show_nodes.PURPOSE: Show enabled nodes and running tasks

M-TIME.NAME: Time utilities
M-TIME.purpose: Sleep utilities for sync and async contexts.

fn-asleep_until.PURPOSE: Async sleep until a given datetime

M-COMPAT.NAME: Compatibility
M-COMPAT.purpose: Type compatibility shims: Self and ParamSpec for older Python versions.

M-DAEMON-SYSTEMD.NAME: Systemd daemon
M-DAEMON-SYSTEMD.purpose: Systemd service entry point for the scheduler daemon.

fn-__main__.PURPOSE: Systemd daemon entry point launching daemonize

M-DAEMON-SYSV.NAME: SysV daemon
M-DAEMON-SYSV.purpose: SysV init service entry point for launching the scheduler daemon.

fn-start_daemon.PURPOSE: SysV daemon entry point with PID file management

M-CONFIG.NAME: Config root
M-CONFIG.purpose: Top-level configuration container aggregating all sub-configs.

class-Config.PURPOSE: Frozen config container parsed from INI file

M-CONFIG-LOCAL.NAME: Local config
M-CONFIG-LOCAL.purpose: Local daemon settings: concurrency limits, webhook config, sleep intervals.

class-ConfigLocal.PURPOSE: Local daemon concurrency and timing settings

M-CONFIG-REMOTE.NAME: Remote config
M-CONFIG-REMOTE.purpose: Remote machine defaults: data directories, SSH username, jump host.

class-ConfigRemote.PURPOSE: Remote machine path and SSH defaults

M-CONFIG-CLOUD.NAME: Cloud configs
M-CONFIG-CLOUD.purpose: Cloud provider configuration dataclasses: Azure, Hetzner, UpCloud.

class-ConfigCloud.PURPOSE: Union of all cloud config types

M-CONFIG-ENGINE.NAME: Engine config
M-CONFIG-ENGINE.purpose: Calculation engine definition: spawn command, check command, deployables, platforms.

type-Deploy.PURPOSE: Union type of all deploy configurations

M-CONFIG-ENGINE-REPO.NAME: Engine repository
M-CONFIG-ENGINE-REPO.purpose: Immutable collection of engines with filtering by platform.

class-EngineRepository.PURPOSE: Frozen dict of engines with filtering

M-CONFIG-UTILS.NAME: Config utilities
M-CONFIG-UTILS.purpose: Shared config helpers: field factories, validators, warning helpers.

fn-make_default_field.PURPOSE: attrs field factory with defaults and validators

M-CLOUD-API.NAME: Cloud API base
M-CLOUD-API.purpose: Generic cloud provider interface: node creation, deletion, SSH key management.

class-CloudAPI.PURPOSE: Generic cloud provider with create/delete/SSH key ops

fn-create_node.PURPOSE: Create VM, wait for SSH, setup node

fn-mk_machine.PURPOSE: Connect to existing IP as RemoteMachine

fn-get_ssh_key_sync.PURPOSE: Load SSH key for cloud provider

M-CLOUD-MANAGER.NAME: Cloud manager
M-CLOUD-MANAGER.purpose: Multi-cloud orchestrator: provider selection, allocation, deallocation, capacity.

export-CLOUD_ADAPTER_GETTERS.PURPOSE: Registry mapping cloud prefix to adapter factory

fn-create.PURPOSE: Async factory: instantiate all configured cloud providers

fn-allocate.PURPOSE: Select provider, create node, wait for ready

fn-select_best_provider.PURPOSE: Pick provider with highest priority and capacity

fn-get_capacity.PURPOSE: Report current capacity across all providers

M-CLOUD-AZ.NAME: Azure provider
M-CLOUD-AZ.purpose: Azure VM creation and deletion using Azure SDK.

fn-az_create_node.PURPOSE: Create Azure VM and return public IP

fn-az_delete_node.PURPOSE: Delete Azure VM and NIC by name

M-CLOUD-HETZNER.NAME: Hetzner provider
M-CLOUD-HETZNER.purpose: Hetzner Cloud server creation and deletion via API.

fn-hetzner_create_node.PURPOSE: Create Hetzner server and return IP

M-CLOUD-UPCLOUD.NAME: UpCloud provider
M-CLOUD-UPCLOUD.purpose: UpCloud server creation and deletion via API.

fn-upcloud_create_node_sync.PURPOSE: Create UpCloud server (sync) and return IP

M-CLOUD-ADAPTERS.NAME: Cloud adapters
M-CLOUD-ADAPTERS.purpose: Mapping of cloud config types to create/delete callables.

class-CloudAdapter.PURPOSE: Frozen attrs class wrapping create/delete callables

M-CLOUD-PROTOCOLS.NAME: Cloud protocols
M-CLOUD-PROTOCOLS.purpose: Protocol definitions for cloud config, node creation, deletion callables.

M-CLOUD-UTILS.NAME: Cloud utilities
M-CLOUD-UTILS.purpose: Cloud helper utilities: random naming, SSH key name extraction.

M-REMOTE.NAME: Remote machine
M-REMOTE.purpose: SSH connection to a remote machine with platform detection, command execution, and SFTP.

class-MySSHClient.PURPOSE: SSH client that trusts all host keys

fn-create.PURPOSE: Async factory: connect SSH, detect platform, create instance

fn-run.PURPOSE: Execute command and wait for completion

fn-sftp.PURPOSE: Async context manager for SFTP session

fn-occupancy_check.PURPOSE: Check if engine process is still running

M-REMOTE-REPO.NAME: Remote machine repository
M-REMOTE-REPO.purpose: Collection of connected remote machines with filtering and cleanup.

fn-disconnect_many.PURPOSE: Close specific SSH connections by IP

M-REMOTE-ADAPTERS.NAME: Remote adapters
M-REMOTE-ADAPTERS.purpose: Platform-specific adapter registry mapping OS identifiers to adapter instances.

M-REMOTE-CHECKS.purpose: SSH-based platform detection check functions for each supported OS.

fn-check_is_linux.PURPOSE: Check if remote is generic Linux via uname

fn-check_is_darwin.PURPOSE: Check if remote is Darwin/macOS via uname

fn-check_is_debian_like.PURPOSE: Check if remote is Debian-like via os-release

fn-check_is_windows.PURPOSE: Check if remote runs Windows with PowerShell

M-REMOTE-COMMON.NAME: Remote common
M-REMOTE-COMMON.purpose: Shared helpers for remote machine operations: process info, command execution.

class-ProcessInfo.PURPOSE: Attrs struct holding pid, name, command

fn-run.PURPOSE: Run process on SSH connection and wait for exit

fn-run_bg.PURPOSE: Create background process on SSH connection

M-REMOTE-EXC.NAME: Remote exceptions
M-REMOTE-EXC.purpose: Custom exceptions for remote machine operations.

class-PlatformGuessFailed.PURPOSE: Raised when no adapter matches detected platform

M-REMOTE-LINUX.NAME: Linux methods
M-REMOTE-LINUX.purpose: Linux-specific remote commands: package install, process listing, CPU detection.

fn-linux_setup_node.PURPOSE: Install packages and setup engines on Linux

fn-linux_list_processes.PURPOSE: Parse ps output into process info

M-REMOTE-WINDOWS.NAME: Windows methods
M-REMOTE-WINDOWS.purpose: Windows-specific remote commands: engine deployment, process listing.

fn-windows_setup_node.PURPOSE: Install packages and setup engines on Windows

fn-windows_list_processes.PURPOSE: Parse tasklist output into process info

M-REMOTE-PROTOCOL.NAME: Remote protocols
M-REMOTE-PROTOCOL.purpose: Protocol definitions for engines, process info, SSH checks, and adapters.

class-AllSSHRetryExc.PURPOSE: Union of all retryable SSH exceptions

M-TEST-CONFTEST.NAME: Test conftest
M-TEST-CONFTEST.purpose: Shared pytest fixtures for the yascheduler test suite.

fn-anyio_backend.PURPOSE: Returns asyncio backend for pytest-anyio compatibility

M-TEST-FIXTURES-MODELS.NAME: Test data helpers
M-TEST-FIXTURES-MODELS.purpose: Factory functions for creating TaskModel and NodeModel instances with sensible defaults.

fn-make_task.PURPOSE: Create TaskModel with defaults and keyword overrides

fn-make_node.PURPOSE: Create NodeModel with defaults and keyword overrides

M-TEST-UNIT-QUEUE.NAME: Queue unit tests
M-TEST-UNIT-QUEUE.purpose: Unit tests for UniqueQueue and UMessage covering deduplication, item lifecycle, and edge cases.

fn-test_put_get.PURPOSE: Put then get returns original message

fn-test_item_done_tracking.PURPOSE: Get adds to pending, item_done removes it

fn-test_item_done_allows_requeue.PURPOSE: After item_done the same message can be re-queued

Project.DF-ALLOCATE-CLOUD: M-SCHEDULER -> M-CLOUD-MANAGER -> M-CLOUD-API -> M-CLOUD-AZ / M-CLOUD-HETZNER / M-CLOUD-UPCLOUD
Project.DF-CONFIG-LOAD: M-CONFIG -> M-CONFIG-DB; M-CONFIG -> M-CONFIG-LOCAL; M-CONFIG -> M-CONFIG-REMOTE; M-CONFIG -> M-CONFIG-CLOUD; M-CONFIG -> M-CONFIG-ENGINE

CrossLink.relation: uploads files, spawns and monitors tasks
connects to newly created cloud VMs
uses engine config as protocol basis
maps Azure config to Azure operations
maps Hetzner config to Hetzner operations
maps UpCloud config to UpCloud operations
